messages:
jason (AE): Heads-up — Sienna Systems is ready for a customer story + joint webinar but they want the case study embargoed until Mar 10. They also asked we include a performance line: "~2.3x inference throughput vs their previous infra". Can we get legal + marketing sign-off on the wording?

emma (Prod Marketing): Great — congrats! Need a clean quote from their CEO and confirmation on the throughput datapoint source. @maria can you confirm which internal benchmark you want us to cite?

maria (Sienna Systems): Hi all — happy to do the quote. The 2.3x number is from our internal A/B over two weeks (batching + kv cache), dataset: internal test corpus (not PII). We can share the CSV export. Quote ok from my side but legal needs to clear wording.

sam (Marcom): For webinar planning: propose Wed Mar 13 or Thu Mar 14, 10am PT. 30–40 min + 10 min Q&A. Do we want a joint demo or just a product deep-dive + customer story?

emma (Prod Marketing): Prefer customer-led demo + a quick 10-min tech primer from infra. @oliver can you draft 1 slide for the benchmark visual and 1 slide for the customer logo/quote?

oliver (Design): On it. I'll put placeholders for the CSV-derived chart and leave a small caption for legal-approved wording. Need final quote text by EOD Tue.

rachel (Legal): I need: (1) the raw CSV or summary table and who ran the test, (2) the exact proposed quote text, and (3) confirmation that no customer PII or regulated data was used. Also we prefer phrasing like "measured on Sienna's internal benchmark suite" instead of "A/B over two weeks".

maria (Sienna Systems): Confirmed: dataset is internal test corpus, no PII. Tests run by Sienna infra team (names: Lee Chen). Will upload CSV + runbook by EOD today. For quote, CEO suggests: "Redwood reduced inference cost and boosted throughput — we saw ~2.3x faster throughput after switching to prefix caching and optimized batching." Thoughts?

emma (Prod Marketing): That's close. To keep marketing claims papered, can we soften to: "Sienna observed ~2.3x increase in throughput on their internal benchmark after enabling prefix caching and batching optimizations with Redwood." @rachel ok with that phrasing?

rachel (Legal): That phrasing is better. I still need the CSV and a brief test summary (who, how long, config). Once I have those, I'll review and provide any redlines. Expect 24–48 hours for formal sign-off.

sam (Marcom): Noted on timeline. For webinar logistics: @maria can you confirm presenter(s) and playback permissions? Also do we need an NDA addendum for the embargoed case study asset?

maria (Sienna Systems): CEO + engineering lead available. Embargo is fine, no extra NDA — standard testimonial release OK. We grant Redwood rights to publish after Mar 10.

marketing-bot: Checklist created — items: [get CSV], [legal review], [final quote], [design assets], [webinar drafts], [recording slot]. Assigned to: jason/emma/oliver/rachel.

emma (Prod Marketing): Great. Action items I have: pull the benchmark snippet for the hero slide (using their CSV when uploaded), lock webinar date tentatively for Mar 13 10am PT and send calendar invites (pending confirmation), draft social/launch copy but will hold publish until legal signs off on numbers.

jason (AE): I'll collect CSV + runbook from Lee and drop in the thread. Also will get CEO to confirm final quote tonight.

oliver (Design): I'll draft two hero variants (one conservative copy, one punchier) so legal can see alternatives.

rachel (Legal): Once CSV + runbook are in thread, I'll review and push redlines here. If anything looks like extrapolation beyond the data, we'll require rewording.

maria (Sienna Systems): Uploading files in 30m. Thanks everyone — excited to partner on this.

emma (Prod Marketing): Thanks — will hold publication until we have legal sign-off and the embargo date. After sign-off, we'll coordinate a pre-launch run-through with Sienna for the webinar. :party_parrot:
